recommendedMatrix.reason: Both captures are TUI MFE component outliers with custom wrappers, weak/generic labels, grouped controls, live regions, duplicate responsive content, and card/pagination boundaries; scan them as one matrix rather than per-site scans.

likelyMismatchFamiliesToBaseline: native-list-versus-custom-tab-label traversal
inline-svg-icon stop or ignored-boundary behavior
active-class-only state not represented as selected/current

domContractsToPreserve.contract: aria-label='search panel container' wrapper; labeled field wrappers with labels using empty for attributes and generic aria-label values; readonly text inputs with empty id, aria-label='text input' or field-specific aria-labels, placeholder/value text, nonstandard shadow attributes, adjacent icon spans/svg, and aria-label='input' error spans.
likelyMismatchFamiliesToBaseline: label/control association absent or generic-name fallback
readonly input versus popup-button-like field wording
decorative icon and empty error span extra stops
group suffixes from input text container wrappers

likelyMismatchFamiliesToBaseline: select accessible name/value versus adjacent visual selected text
disabled option metadata
generic aria-label overriding visible button text

domContractsToPreserve.contract: header title/subtitle divs; visually-hidden auto-update notice; visible group title divs 'When', 'Where', and 'Weather'; native month select without explicit label; collapsed combobox div with aria-haspopup=listbox, aria-owns, aria-expanded=false, input aria-autocomplete=list and aria-controls; weather buttons with nested title and subtitle spans and active class only.

collapsed combobox wrapper plus inner textbox decomposition
button name joining title/subtitle temperature text
active class not equivalent to pressed/selected state

omissionSafety.omit: remote scripts such as choice-search-panel index.js
omissionSafety.whySafe: The receipt is based on already-rendered DOM fragments; dynamic script behavior must be represented only by preserved initial DOM state unless original step snapshots prove conditional state.
Path geometry is not accessibility-relevant; keep the svg element placement, size attributes, and lack of aria-hidden/title instead.

omissionSafety.omit: remote background image bytes and network image fetching
omissionSafety.whySafe: Use repo-local or inert image sources while preserving img elements, missing alt attributes, style/background-image presence, and sibling order; do not rely on public hosting.

omissionSafety.omit: additional weather cards beyond enough first, middle, and pagination context
omissionSafety.whySafe: Card labels can be shortened if the disputed behavior is card/link/group/region traversal rather than long text, wrapping, or truncation.

suggestedNegativeControls: A proper label/for/id text input beside the holiday empty-for generic-label pattern.
The same holiday icon wrappers with aria-hidden=true to distinguish SVG/image stops from structural grouping.
Weather buttons with explicit aria-pressed or aria-label values beside the source active-class-only buttons.
A single card with .top-mobile display:none and one with both desktop/mobile visible to bind duplicate responsive behavior to AX visibility.
An img icon with alt='' beside the source no-alt img icons.
A normal nav > ul pagination control beside ul role='navigation' pagination.
A hidden aria-live count region beside a visible role=region result wrapper to separate live-region announcement from traversal.

identityMarkers.scanRoot: Use one data-sr-scan-root wrapper around the matrix surface.

recommendedCanary.purpose: Prove repo-local fixture path, scan root identity, non-empty rendered HTML, AX nodes, and step snapshots.

recommendedFullScan.purpose: Reach search controls, weather cards, and pagination while preserving debug evidence for live-region and focus/order questions.

risks: Duplicate desktop/mobile weather card content may double traversal unless CSS hidden state matches the original AX evidence.
aria-live regions may create startup or update announcements that must be separated from initial DOM traversal.
No-alt remote img icons may add image stops or filename-derived names if not preserved carefully with local equivalents.
Large inline SVGs bloat HTML but should not drive step count once path data is shortened.
Pagination tabindex=-1 controls may be skipped or reached depending on VoiceOver navigation mode; step snapshots are required.

decisions: Do not assert expected VoiceOver lines from the two HTML fragments alone.
Treat missing original AX evidence as a blocker for any engine-ready verdict until the next C.5 worker binds the reproduction to original AX contracts or records the absence explicitly.
Use existing TUI repro conventions: repo-local voiceover-repros path, data-sr-scan-root, short text where text length is not disputed, and no promotion to live-site corpus fixtures.
No fixture, engine, expected announcement, manifest, or reusable logic file was modified.
